problems: compare table row ["잘하는 곳", "무르거나 험한 땅", "단단한 땅, 짧은 거리 이동"]: '짧은 거리 이동' is wrong/misleading. The standard textbook and exam point is the opposite: the wheel type has better mobility and higher travel speed (about 25~40km/h vs 2.5~10km/h for crawlers), so it suits paved roads and moving long distances by itself, while a crawler needs a trailer for long moves. Suggested fix: '단단하고 평평한 땅, 도로 이동·장거리 이동(기동성 좋음)'.

problems: compare table row ["시동 보조", "예열 플러그", "점화 장치"]: misleading. The ignition system (spark plug, ignition coil) is how a gasoline engine burns fuel on every combustion stroke. It is not a starting aid. A gasoline engine has no counterpart to the diesel glow plug (preheating), so a learner may wrongly learn '점화장치 = 시동보조장치'. Suggested fix: rename the row to '불을 붙이는 장치' (diesel: none, compression heat / gasoline: spark plug and ignition system), or write '시동 보조: 예열 플러그 / 따로 필요 없음'.
notes: 4-stroke order and 2 crankshaft revolutions per cycle, compression ignition, glow plug, bleeding air from the fuel system, oil functions (윤활·냉각·밀봉·청정·방청), thermostat stuck closed → overheating, overheating causes, black smoke = incomplete combustion / clogged air cleaner, grey-white smoke = burning oil: all correct.
